full_prompt_en: A square expressionist ink-and-paint image shows a solemn crowd of elongated figures in the foreground, with a dark harbor and pale city buildings behind them. The upper strip of sky is mustard yellow crossed by rough horizontal black marks. Below it, a row of gray-white multistory facades stretches across the far shore, their windows and roofs scratched in with dense, uneven linework. A broad dark water band separates this built distance from the people; two black boats with tall masts and webbed rigging cut across the middle. In the foreground, the figures stand tightly packed from edge to edge, cropped at the chest by the bottom of the frame. Their faces are long, pale, and masklike, with narrow vertical noses, dark abbreviated eyes, and restrained mouths. The largest central face sits above a broad red coat, while similarly colored garments form strong red blocks at the left and right. A taller dark-clothed figure rises slightly behind the center, and smaller pale faces peer from gaps in the group. Thin black lines run over the garments and faces, giving the bodies a scraped, nervous texture. The harbor's many fine horizontals contrast with the upright heads and masts. The light is flat and graphic rather than from a distinct lamp, with ivory faces and buildings standing out against black water and clothing. Red, yellow ocher, bone white, and deep charcoal are the dominant colors, with little smooth blending. The image looks drawn and abraded on a rough surface; strokes are visible in nearly every region. There is no readable text. The overall composition is crowded and still, using repeated pale vertical forms and broad red planes to make the group feel both collective and isolated.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现主义墨线加颜料画面呈现前景一群肃穆、形体拉长的人物，身后是深色港口和浅色城市建筑。上方狭窄天空呈芥末黄，被粗糙黑色水平痕迹划过。下方一排灰白多层楼房沿远岸展开，窗与屋顶由密集不匀的线条刮画出来。一道宽阔暗色水带把这片建成的远方与人物分开；两艘黑船以高桅杆和网状索具切过中部。前景人物从边到边紧密站立，胸部被画框底缘裁断。他们的面孔狭长、苍白而像面具，有细长竖鼻、简短的深色眼睛和收敛的嘴。最大的中央脸位于宽阔红外套上方，相近颜色的衣服在左右形成有力红色块。一个较高、穿深色衣服的人略微立在中央后方，更小的浅色面孔从人群间隙探出。细黑线穿过衣服和脸，让身体带着刮擦般紧张肌理。港口里众多细水平线与直立的头和桅杆相对。光平坦而图形化，不来自特定灯具；象牙白的脸和建筑从黑色水面与衣服前凸显。红、黄赭、骨白和深炭色主导配色，几乎没有平滑混合。图像像画在粗糙表面又被磨损；几乎每一处都有可见笔痕。没有可读文字。整体构图拥挤而静止，以重复的浅色竖形与宽阔红色平面让群体既显得集体又显得孤立。
style_prompt_en: The expressionist mixed-media drawing uses elongated, simplified shapes and nervous black strokes over rough blocks of limited color. Bone white and ocher establish pale zones, deep charcoal builds dense recesses, and saturated brick red concentrates visual weight in a few broad areas. Thin vertical marks repeat against scraped horizontal bands, creating a taut rhythm across the square. Edges are firm in major silhouettes but broken by hatch marks and scratches inside and around them. Space is compressed into shallow stacked layers rather than naturalistic perspective; small background marks remain insistently visible. Illumination is graphic and even, relying on value contrast rather than modeled highlights or cast shadows. The overall effect is austere, crowded, and emotionally charged, with irregular linework making simple forms feel unsettled.
style_prompt_zh: 这种表现主义混合媒介绘画在有限颜色的粗糙色块上使用拉长、简化的形状与紧张黑色笔痕。骨白与赭黄建立浅色区域，深炭色构成密集凹处，饱和砖红把视觉重量集中在少数宽块中。细竖痕在刮擦式水平带前反复出现，使方画幅形成紧绷节奏。主要剪影边缘坚定，却被内部及周围的排线与刮痕打破。空间压缩为浅浅堆叠的层次，而非自然主义透视；背景的小笔痕依然执拗地可见。光线图形化且均匀，依赖明度对照，而不是塑形高光或投影。整体效果严峻、拥挤且情感强烈，不规则线条让简单形体显得不安定。
theme_en: A solemn crowd in red coats before a dark harbor
theme_zh: 深色港口前穿红色外套的肃穆人群
name: Bernard Buffet
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
